# Vendored MalverdeSoftware packages

Exact, packed versions of the shared MalverdeSoftware packages, installed with `npm install --save-exact`. They are committed here so a fresh clone builds without any other checkout. See [CONSUMING](https://github.com/MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware/blob/main/docs/CONSUMING.md).

Commit hashes refer to the private development history of the shared packages (`MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware-history`); the public repository starts at its first public release.

| Tarball | Version | Packed from |
|---|---|---|
| `malverdesoftware-ui-0.1.1.tgz` | 0.1.1 | MalverdeSoftware/malverdesoftware `2c4bbce` |

The package is Apache-2.0, copyright The Johns Hopkins University. From 0.1.1 on, the tarball contains LICENSE and NOTICE.
